The AI funding trade just changed shape in one day:

hits.name: unusual_whales
hits.text:
Only 2.2% of mortgaged homes are underwater, per Goldman Sachs.

In 2008, it was roughly 1 in 4.
hits.draft_en:
This is not 2008. It's a freeze.

• Only 2.2% of mortgaged homes underwater (vs ~1 in 4 in 2008)
• Pending home sales at a record low
• Builder confidence lowest since 2012, a record 43% of builders cutting prices

No forced sellers + no buyers = volume collapses, prices barely move.
hits.video_tip: Talking-head 20s with two lower-third stats (2.2% vs ~1 in 4), then a quick cut to the pending-home-sales chart; hook line on screen in first second.

BREAKING: Brazil's stock market collapses nearly -30% and the Brazilian Real loses -10% after President Lula da Silva is unexpectedly re-elected.

Brazil's stock market has lost over $200 billion of market cap today. https://t.co/XsHVYmepvV
hits.draft_en:
Brazil just printed a crisis-grade session after Lula's re-election:

• Stocks down nearly -30%
• Real -10%
• 10Y yield pushing 16%, +300bp in ONE day

And the volatility index fell -40%.

When the vol gauge drops while the market craters, ask what's actually being hedged — and who's left holding the tail.
hits.video_tip: 15s chart-on-screen: Brazil equities vs 10Y yield vs vol index side by side; voiceover reads the three numbers, freeze on the -40% vol print.

narrative_synthesis: 464 originals cleared 5k views (451 at 10k+) out of 477 pulled. Two stories dominated: Microsoft's 60,000-worker buyout offer (9.83M views on KobeissiLetter alone) and Anthropic's S-1 (57 posts). Brazil's post-election crash was the macro story of the day; Iran/Hormuz and China weakness ran underneath.
